fusions.name: Blood from the Lid
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Squirts your own blood from under the lid at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 9 blood damage, with a 60% chance of [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Basilisk Regard
fusions.desc: Stares down a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage and stunning each enemy in it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Unblinking Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
